Unlike utilization paper, use the seer time of diagnosis mets variable. The utilization paper actually used a claims derived mets site, which could introduce immortal time bias in the safety paper since the claims based was defined over the course of follow-up? double check -- may have just put a time restriction.

```{r}
table(data2$SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010, useNA = "always")
# =============================================================================
# SEER-derived visceral metastasis variables for IPTW PS model
# Variable interpretation: count of major visceral sites (brain/bone/liver/lung)
# Note: All patients are stage IV by definition, so n=0 means primary mets
# are at sites other than the four SEER-coded visceral organs
# =============================================================================

summary(data2$sex_recode)
# Step 1: Create site-specific binary indicators with explicit NA handling
# SEER codes: 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 9 = Unknown, NA = Not coded
# Treat 9 and NA together as "Unknown" — do NOT silently assume "No"
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    seer_brain = case_when(
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    seer_bone = case_when(
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_BONE_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_BONE_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                   ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    seer_liver = case_when(
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_LIVER_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_LIVER_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    seer_lung = case_when(
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_LUNG_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_LUNG_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(seer_brain, seer_bone, seer_liver, seer_lung),
                ~ factor(., levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))))

# QC: confirm site-level distributions
cat("\n=== Site-specific SEER metastasis distributions ===\n")
table(data2$seer_brain, useNA = "always")
table(data2$seer_bone,  useNA = "always")
table(data2$seer_liver, useNA = "always")
table(data2$seer_lung,  useNA = "always")

# Step 2: Count confirmed visceral metastatic sites
# Range: 0-4. Count is "number of visceral organs with confirmed metastasis."
# Sites coded Unknown contribute 0 to the count but are tracked separately.
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    seer_brain_bin = as.integer(seer_brain == "Yes"),
    seer_bone_bin  = as.integer(seer_bone  == "Yes"),
    seer_liver_bin = as.integer(seer_liver == "Yes"),
    seer_lung_bin  = as.integer(seer_lung  == "Yes"),
    
    n_visceral_mets = seer_brain_bin + seer_bone_bin + seer_liver_bin + seer_lung_bin,
    
    n_unknown_sites = (seer_brain == "Unknown") +
                      (seer_bone  == "Unknown") +
                      (seer_liver == "Unknown") +
                      (seer_lung  == "Unknown")
  )

cat("\n=== Confirmed visceral mets count by exposure ===\n")
table(data2$n_visceral_mets, data2$exposure_arm, useNA = "always")

cat("\n=== Distribution of sites with unknown status ===\n")
table(data2$n_unknown_sites, useNA = "always")

# Step 3: Define a categorical version interpreting n=0 as "non-visceral primary"
# Note the explicit labeling — patients with 0 confirmed visceral sites do have
# stage IV disease, but their metastatic site is not one of the four SEER-coded organs
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    visceral_mets_cat = case_when(
      n_visceral_mets == 0 & n_unknown_sites == 0 ~ "Non-visceral Mets Site",
      n_visceral_mets == 0 & n_unknown_sites > 0  ~ "Indeterminate",
      n_visceral_mets == 1                        ~ "1 visceral site",
      n_visceral_mets == 2                        ~ "2 visceral sites",
      n_visceral_mets >= 3                        ~ "3+ visceral sites"
    ),
    visceral_mets_cat = factor(visceral_mets_cat,
                               levels = c("Non-visceral Mets Site",
                                          "1 visceral site",
                                          "2 visceral sites",
                                          "3+ visceral sites",
                                          "Indeterminate"))
  )

cat("\n=== visceral_mets_cat by exposure ===\n")
table(data2$visceral_mets_cat, data2$exposure_arm, useNA = "always")

# Step 4: Prepare for PS model with missing-indicator approach
# Continuous version for interactions, with explicit flag for indeterminate patients
cohort_median_visceral <- median(data2$n_visceral_mets[
  data2$visceral_mets_cat != "Indeterminate"
], na.rm = TRUE)

data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    # Continuous variable for PS interactions
    n_visceral_mets_cont = ifelse(visceral_mets_cat == "Indeterminate",
                                   cohort_median_visceral,
                                   n_visceral_mets),
    
    # Missing-indicator flag for indeterminate status
    indeterminate_mets = as.integer(visceral_mets_cat == "Indeterminate")
  )

cat("\n=== Imputation verification ===\n")
cat("Cohort median visceral mets:", cohort_median_visceral, "\n")
cat("n with indeterminate flag:", sum(data2$indeterminate_mets), "\n")
table(data2$n_visceral_mets_cont, data2$indeterminate_mets, useNA = "always")


```

```{r}
data <- data2

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE VARIABLE TYPES
# =============================================================================

cat_vars <- c("sex_recode", "race_binary", "radiation_binary", "yost_tertile",
  "pre_ici_surg", "charlson_recode", "autoimmune_recode", "braf_recode", 
  "firstline_ici_recode", "histo_C", "primary_site_group",
  "seer_brain", "visceral_mets_cat"
)

cont_vars <- c("days_dx_to_tx", "AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100",
               "n_visceral_mets_cont", "indeterminate_mets")

# All covariates for PS model
all_covariates <- c(cat_vars, cont_vars)
# =============================================================================
# DIAGNOSE: Find factors with <2 levels
# =============================================================================

cat("--- Checking factor levels ---\n")
for (var in cat_vars) {
  n_levels <- length(unique(na.omit(data[[var]])))
  cat(var, ":", n_levels, "levels\n")
  if (n_levels < 2) {
    cat("  *** PROBLEM: Only 1 level! ***\n")
    print(table(data[[var]], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
}

```
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA FOR PSM
# =============================================================================

data_ps <- data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cat_vars), as.factor))

data_ps <- data_ps %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cont_vars), as.numeric))

data_ps <- data_ps %>%
  mutate(
    dual = case_when(
      exposure_arm == "Dual (PD-1 + CTLA-4) ICI therapy" ~ 1,
      exposure_arm == "Single (PD-1 or CTLA-4) ICI therapy" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

cat("--- Treatment Distribution ---\n")
table(data_ps$dual, data_ps$exposure_arm, useNA = "ifany")

cat("\n--- Variable Types ---\n")
data_ps %>%
  select(all_of(all_covariates)) %>%
  sapply(class) %>%
  print()

cat("\n--- Missingness ---\n")
data_ps %>%
  select(all_of(all_covariates), dual) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0) %>%
  print()

# =============================================================================
# DROP MISSING BEFORE PSM
# =============================================================================

cat("N before dropping missing:", nrow(data_ps), "\n")

data_ps_complete <- data_ps %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(charlson_recode),
    !is.na(autoimmune_recode),
    !is.na(primary_site_group)
  )

cat("N after dropping missing:", nrow(data_ps_complete), "\n")
cat("Dropped:", nrow(data_ps) - nrow(data_ps_complete), "patients\n")

data_ps_complete %>%
  select(all_of(all_covariates), dual) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0)

cat("\n--- Treatment Distribution (Complete Cases) ---\n")
table(data_ps_complete$dual, useNA = "ifany")
```
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PROPENSITY SCORE MODEL
# =============================================================================

# Note: visceral_mets_cat and n_visceral_mets_cont are collinear by design.
# Use the categorical version OR the continuous + indeterminate flag, not both.
# Here we use the continuous + indeterminate flag for the burden gradient,
# and drop the categorical from the PS formula to avoid singularity.

ps_covariates <- c(setdiff(all_covariates, "visceral_mets_cat"))

ps_formula <- as.formula(paste(
  "dual ~",
  paste(ps_covariates, collapse = " + "),
  "+ AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100:n_visceral_mets_cont",
  "+ sex_recode:n_visceral_mets_cont"
))

cat("\n--- PS Model Formula ---\n")
print(ps_formula)

ps_model <- glm(
  ps_formula,
  data = data_ps_complete,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

if (!ps_model$converged) {
  warning("Model did not converge!")
}

data_ps_complete <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(ps = predict(ps_model, type = "response"))
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE IPTW WEIGHTS
# =============================================================================

pbar <- mean(data_ps_complete$dual, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\nPrevalence of Dual therapy:", round(pbar, 4), "\n")

data_ps_complete <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(
    uw = ifelse(dual == 1, 1 / ps, 1 / (1 - ps)),
    sw = ifelse(dual == 1, pbar / ps, (1 - pbar) / (1 - ps))
  )

# Trim weights at 1st and 99th percentile
sw_p1 <- quantile(data_ps_complete$sw, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
sw_p99 <- quantile(data_ps_complete$sw, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nTrimming thresholds:\n")
cat("  1st percentile:", round(sw_p1, 4), "\n")
cat("  99th percentile:", round(sw_p99, 4), "\n")

data_ps_complete <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(
    sw_t = pmax(pmin(sw, sw_p99), sw_p1)
  )

cat("\n--- Weight Summary by Treatment Group ---\n")
data_ps_complete %>%
  group_by(dual) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_ps = round(mean(ps, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    mean_sw = round(mean(sw, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    mean_sw_t = round(mean(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    min_sw_t = round(min(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    max_sw_t = round(max(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("\nOverall mean of trimmed stabilized weights:", 
    round(mean(data_ps_complete$sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "(should be ~1)\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# LOVE PLOT - COVARIATE BALANCE
# =============================================================================

data_ps_complete$weights_iptw <- data_ps_complete$sw_t

love.plot(
  ps_model,
  binary = "std",
  continuous = "std",
  s.d.denom = "pooled",
  thresholds = c(m = 0.1),
  var.order = "unadjusted",
  abs = TRUE,
  weights = data_ps_complete$sw_t,
  colors = c("firebrick", "steelblue"),
  shapes = c("circle", "triangle"),
  title = "Covariate Balance Before and After IPTW"
) +
  theme_classic()

# Tabulate n by treatment within problem covariates
table(data$visceral_mets_cat, data$exposure_arm)
table(data$seer_brain, data$exposure_arm)
```

```{r}


# Unweighted
tab_unw <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = all_covariates,
  strata = "dual",
  data = data_ps_complete,
  test = FALSE,
  smd = TRUE
)

# Weighted
design_wt <- svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~sw_t, data = data_ps_complete)
tab_wt <- svyCreateTableOne(
  vars = all_covariates,
  strata = "dual",
  data = design_wt,
  test = FALSE,
  smd = TRUE
)


# =============================================================================
# IDENTIFY COVARIATES WITH POOR BALANCE AFTER WEIGHTING
# =============================================================================

# Extract SMDs from weighted table
smd_matrix <- ExtractSmd(tab_wt)
poor_balance <- smd_matrix[abs(smd_matrix[, 1]) >= 0.1, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(poor_balance) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- Covariates with |SMD| >= 0.1 after weighting ---\n")
  print(poor_balance)
} else {
  cat("\n--- All covariates balanced (|SMD| < 0.1) after weighting ---\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# SAVE
# =============================================================================

#saveRDS(data_ps_complete, "../Data/processed/skin_ici_psweighted.rds")


```

```{r}
# --- Derived variables --------------------------------------------------------
d_ps <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(
    months_to_end_fu2 = years_to_end_followup2 * 12,
    log_fu2 = log(years_to_end_followup2),
    sw_t_norm = sw_t / mean(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    exposure_arm_f = factor(exposure_arm)
  )

mean(data_ps_complete$sw_t, na.rm = TRUE)      
mean(data_ps_complete$sw_t_norm, na.rm = TRUE) 

#===============================================================================
# SECTION 1: DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
#===============================================================================

# Cross-tabulation: exposure_arm by event status
table(d_ps$exposure_arm, d_ps$censor_flag2)
prop.table(table(d_ps$exposure_arm, d_ps$censor_flag2), margin = 1) %>% round(4)

# Follow-up duration by exposure arm
d_ps %>%
  group_by(exposure_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_years  = mean(years_to_end_followup2, na.rm = TRUE),
    wt_mean_yrs = weighted.mean(years_to_end_followup2, w = sw_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25 = quantile(years_to_end_followup2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p50 = quantile(years_to_end_followup2, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75 = quantile(years_to_end_followup2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(years_to_end_followup2, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(years_to_end_followup2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Check for negative follow-up
d_ps %>% filter(years_to_end_followup2 < 0)
```
CIF models:
```{r}
#===============================================================================
# SECTION 2: CUMULATIVE INCIDENCE FUNCTIONS (CIF)
#===============================================================================

# Unweighted CIF
cif_fit <- cmprsk::cuminc(
  ftime   = d_ps$years_to_end_followup2,
  fstatus = d_ps$censor_flag2,
  group   = d_ps$exposure_arm
)

# Print CIF estimates at specific time points
timepoints_cif <- timepoints(cif_fit, times = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3))
print(timepoints_cif$est)

# Gray's test for equality of CIFs
print(cif_fit$Tests)

cif_tidy <- cuminc(Surv(years_to_end_followup2, factor(censor_flag2)) ~ exposure_arm,
                    data = d_ps)
cif_tidy %>%
  ggcuminc(outcome = "1") +
  labs(
    x = "Years",
    y = "Cumulative Incidence of Severe irAE",
    title = "Cumulative Incidence of Severe irAE by Exposure Arm"
  ) +
  add_risktable() +
  theme_minimal()
```
Fine-Gray Models:
```{r}
#===============================================================================
# SECTION 3: FINE-GRAY SUBDISTRIBUTION HAZARD MODELS
#===============================================================================

# Step 1: Create Fine-Gray expanded dataset
# Updated to include new SEER mets variables for downstream stratified analyses
fg_data <- finegray(
  Surv(years_to_end_followup2, factor(censor_flag2)) ~ .,
  data = d_ps %>% select(PATIENT_ID, years_to_end_followup2, censor_flag2,
                         exposure_arm, sw_t_norm, age_75_binary, 
                         visceral_mets_cat, seer_brain, pre_ici_surg),
  etype = "1"
)

# Add combined weight for IPTW analysis (FG weights × IPTW weights)
fg_data <- fg_data %>%
  mutate(combined_wt = fgwt * sw_t_norm)

# Step 2a: Unadjusted Fine-Gray model
fg_unadj <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
  data = fg_data,
  weights = fgwt,
  id = PATIENT_ID,
  robust = TRUE
)

summary(fg_unadj)

cat("\n--- Unadjusted Subdistribution HR ---\n")
cat(sprintf("sHR = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f), p = %.4f\n",
            exp(coef(fg_unadj)),
            exp(confint(fg_unadj))[1],
            exp(confint(fg_unadj))[2],
            summary(fg_unadj)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]))

# Step 2b: IPTW-Weighted Fine-Gray model
fg_iptw <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
  data = fg_data,
  weights = combined_wt,
  id = PATIENT_ID,
  robust = TRUE
)
summary(fg_iptw)

cat("\n--- IPTW-Weighted Subdistribution HR ---\n")
cat(sprintf("sHR = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f), p = %.4f\n",
            exp(coef(fg_iptw)),
            exp(confint(fg_iptw))[1],
            exp(confint(fg_iptw))[2],
            summary(fg_iptw)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]))

# Step 2c: IPTW-Weighted Fine-Gray 1 year restriction
fg_data_1yr <- fg_data %>%
  mutate(
    fgstop_1yr = pmin(fgstop, 1),
    fgstatus_1yr = ifelse(fgstop <= 1, fgstatus, 0)
  )
    
fg_iptw_1y <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop_1yr, fgstatus_1yr) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
  data = fg_data_1yr,
  weights = combined_wt,
  id = PATIENT_ID,
  robust = TRUE
)

summary(fg_iptw_1y)

cat("\n--- IPTW-Weighted Subdistribution 1-yr HR ---\n")
cat(sprintf("sHR = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f), p = %.4f\n",
            exp(coef(fg_iptw_1y)),
            exp(confint(fg_iptw_1y))[1],
            exp(confint(fg_iptw_1y))[2],
            summary(fg_iptw_1y)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]))

# 6-month restriction
fg_data_6m <- fg_data %>%
  mutate(
    fgstop_6m  = pmin(fgstop, 0.5),
    fgstatus_6m = ifelse(fgstop <= 0.5, fgstatus, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(fgstop_6m > fgstart)

nrow(fg_data) - nrow(fg_data_6m)

fg_iptw_6m <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop_6m, fgstatus_6m) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
  data = fg_data_6m,
  weights = combined_wt,
  id = PATIENT_ID,
  robust = TRUE
)

cat("\n--- IPTW-Weighted Subdistribution 6m HR ---\n")
cat(sprintf("sHR = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f), p = %.4f\n",
            exp(coef(fg_iptw_6m)),
            exp(confint(fg_iptw_6m))[1],
            exp(confint(fg_iptw_6m))[2],
            summary(fg_iptw_6m)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]))
```
Schoenfeld tests:
```{r}
# PH test for the Fine-Gray irAE models

# Full - adj
cox.zph(fg_iptw)
plot(cox.zph(fg_iptw), main = "Schoenfeld Residuals - irAE (Fine-Gray)")

# 1 year - adj
cox.zph(fg_iptw_1y)

# 6 months - adj
cox.zph(fg_iptw_6m)
plot(cox.zph(fg_iptw_6m), main = "Schoenfeld Residuals - irAE (Fine-Gray)")
```

```{r}
    cat("Skipping — insufficient sample size or single exposure group\n")
    next

    Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
    data    = fg_sub,
```

# =============================================================================
# PREVALENCE OF SEVERE irAE BY EXPOSURE ARM (entire follow-up)
# =============================================================================

```{r}
# Unweighted
data_ps_complete %>%
  group_by(exposure_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_events = sum(censor_flag2 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_pct = round(100 * n_events / n, 1),
    total_pyrs = round(sum(years_to_end_followup2, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    rate_per_100pyrs = round(100 * n_events / total_pyrs, 2)
  )

# IPTW-weighted
data_ps_complete %>%
  group_by(exposure_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    wt_n = round(sum(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    wt_events = round(sum(sw_t * (censor_flag2 == 1), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    wt_prevalence_pct = round(100 * wt_events / wt_n, 1),
    wt_pyrs = round(sum(sw_t * years_to_end_followup2, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    wt_rate_per_100pyrs = round(100 * wt_events / wt_pyrs, 2)
  )
```

```{r, results figure}
library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(patchwork)

navy <- "#1F3864"; ltblue <- "#9DC3E6"; hi <- "#C55A11"; grey <- "#7F7F7F"

lv <- c("CheckMate 067", "RELATIVITY-047", "This study")

# Trial values = grade 3-4 TRAE. This study = 180-d weighted CIF. REPLACE placeholders.
ae <- tribble(
  ~cohort,          ~regimen,       ~pct, ~ph,
  "CheckMate 067",  "Single-agent", 16.3, FALSE,
  "CheckMate 067",  "Dual-agent",   55.0, FALSE,
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Single-agent",  9.7, FALSE,
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Dual-agent",   18.9, FALSE,
  "This study",     "Single-agent", 25.0, TRUE,
  "This study",     "Dual-agent",   35.0, TRUE
) |>
  mutate(cohort  = factor(cohort, lv),
         regimen = factor(regimen, c("Single-agent", "Dual-agent")),
         lab     = ifelse(ph, "\u2014", sprintf("%.1f", pct)))

fold <- ae |>
  select(cohort, regimen, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = regimen, values_from = pct) |>
  mutate(lab = sprintf("%.1f\u00d7", `Dual-agent` / `Single-agent`),
         y   = `Dual-agent` + 9)

pA <- ggplot(ae, aes(cohort, pct, fill = regimen)) +
  geom_col(aes(linetype = ph), position = position_dodge(0.72), width = 0.62,
           colour = navy, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab), position = position_dodge(0.72),
            vjust = -0.6, size = 3.1, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_text(data = fold, aes(cohort, y, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 3.5, fontface = 2, colour = navy) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Single-agent" = ltblue, "Dual-agent" = navy)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "22"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous("Severe adverse events (%)", limits = c(0, 70),
                     breaks = seq(0, 60, 20), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.margin = margin(b = -4), legend.key.size = unit(9, "pt"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(6, 12, 2, 6))

rows <- rev(c("Median age", "ECOG 0\u20131 required", "Brain metastases",
              "Autoimmune history", "Age \u226575"))

pop <- tribble(
  ~cohort,          ~item,                  ~value,
  "CheckMate 067",  "Median age",           "61",
  "CheckMate 067",  "ECOG 0\u20131 required","Required",
  "CheckMate 067",  "Brain metastases",     "Excluded",
  "CheckMate 067",  "Autoimmune history",   "Excluded",
  "CheckMate 067",  "Age \u226575",          "Rare",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Median age",           "63",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "ECOG 0\u20131 required","Required",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Brain metastases",     "Excluded",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Autoimmune history",   "Excluded",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Age \u226575",          "Rare",
  "This study",     "Median age",           "74",
  "This study",     "ECOG 0\u20131 required","Unmeasured",
  "This study",     "Brain metastases",     "Included",
  "This study",     "Autoimmune history",   "Included",
  "This study",     "Age \u226575",          "Majority"
) |>
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, lv),
         item   = factor(item, rows),
         col    = ifelse(cohort == "This study", hi, grey))

pB <- ggplot(pop, aes(cohort, item)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = cohort == "This study"), colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = value, colour = col), size = 3.05) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#EDF2F9", `TRUE` = "#FBEFE6"), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom", expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(0)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = 2, colour = navy, size = 9.5,
                                   margin = margin(t = 3)),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 8.6, colour = "grey25"),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 12, 6, 6))

fig <- pA / pB +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2.3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste("Trials: grade 3\u20134 treatment-related AEs.",
                    "This study: 180-day weighted cumulative incidence of severe irAE,",
                    "death as competing event."),
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 7.6,
                                              colour = "grey35",
                                              margin = margin(t = 6)),
                  plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)))

ragg::agg_tiff("fig_benchmark.tiff", width = 7.2, height = 5.4,

print(fig)
```
